stats.instrumentType: Doubles as a flute when blown across the top
stats.description: A quarterstaff Ganji carved himself with his enchanted knife, hollowed through the core and pierced with fingerholes so that blowing across its top turns it into a full-sized flute. He built it disguised as a weapon on purpose: he was meant to be training combat, not music, so a 'quarterstaff' that was secretly a flute let him practice openly without ever having to hide it.
stats.bonus: Carved and fitted by his own hand to his exact grip and reach; grants advantage on his first attack roll with it in each fight, and functions as a proper musical instrument.
stats.origin: Self-carved using Ganji's enchanted carving knife, built specifically to disguise a flute as a training weapon.
